boundaries: Agent used production ports deterministically, not autonomous model inference.
Remote test used the real local overlay setter with remote metadata, not network relay merge or cross-device convergence.
Catalog test used the actual host registry, not marketplace/theme approval.
Credential ordering/rollback and dual-queue reads used synthetic IPC, not real encrypted files or user credentials.
Read-error recovery, coalescing, cap and queued retirement are unit tests, not native stress claims.
Legacy settings.changed stays domain-command-only. Use queries.observe for all-source projections. Unknown legacy actors stay null.
Revision is process-local, not replay, CAS, a sync clock or exactly-once delivery. Hidden/no-op changes may advance it without delivery.
Packaged/Windows/Linux, full settings drafts/effects, full backup restore and remote credential publication remain unverified.
